svg.title: Alkaline reverse osmosis certification tiers: NSF/ANSI 58 versus components versus NSF/ANSI 372
svg.desc: Three tiers of certification evidence for alkaline reverse osmosis systems: a system certified to NSF/ANSI 58 such as the Waterdrop X12 and iSpring RCC7AK, systems built from certified components such as the Home Master TMAFC and TMHP, and a third tier, systems listed only to NSF/ANSI 372 for lead content, which none of the four picks relies on.
svg.text: What "NSF certified" means on each alkaline RO
Tested on what the RO removes. Each contaminant claim is listed separately.
Waterdrop X12: IAPMO, NSF/ANSI 58 (TDS) and 42 (chlorine, taste)
Parts meet NSF materials standards. What the whole system removes is not certified.
Home Master TMAFC and TMHP: "NSF certified components"
No system listing cited by the maker
Lead content of the parts that touch water. Says nothing about removal.
None of the four picks here relies on a 372 listing alone
If 372 is the only listing, nothing proves what it removes
From maker pages and a third-party directory check, August 2026. Confirm on the certifier's listing.
